/**

export const generateOptimizedPrompt = async (data: ProductData): Promise<string> => {
  const ai = getAI();
  try {
    const parts: any[] = [];
    if (data.imageBase64 && data.mimeType) {
      const base64Data = data.imageBase64.split(',')[1];
      parts.push({ inlineData: { mimeType: data.mimeType, data: base64Data } });
    }

    const templateInstruction = data.description ? `Visual concept (Vietnamese): "${data.description}"` : "";

    const promptInput = `
    Role: Professional AI Prompt Architect for high-end pharmaceutical marketing.
    Goal: Create a masterpiece text-to-image prompt for Midjourney/Stable Diffusion.
    
    Product Details:
    - Name: ${data.name}
    - Dosage: ${data.dosage}
    - Usage: ${data.usage}
    - Mfr: ${data.manufacturer}
    - IDECO Special Price: ${data.idecoPrice}
    
    Format: ${data.aspectRatio === 'vertical' ? 'Vertical Poster (3:4 ratio)' : 'Horizontal Banner (16:9 ratio)'}.
    
    Core Instructions:
    - ${templateInstruction}
    - If the concept mentions a "female pharmacist", describe her as highly professional, empathetic, and expert, pointing at the product with confidence.
    - If it's a "3D Packshot", emphasize photorealistic textures, product layering, and sharp highlights.
    - CRITICAL: The price label "${data.idecoPrice}" must be an eye-catching, professionally designed UI element on the poster.
    - Style: Clean, medical, high-end, commercial photography.
    
    Response format: Return ONLY the detailed English prompt string.
    `;
    parts.push({ text: promptInput });

    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
      model: 'gemini-3-flash-preview', 
      contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: parts }],
    });
    return response.text || "";
  } catch (error) {
    throw error;
  }
};

  const ai = getAI();
  const base64Data = imageBase64.split(',')[1];
  
  const prompts = {
    remove_bg: "Segment and remove the background from this medical product perfectly. Result must be isolated on white.",
    make_3d: "Convert this product image into a 3D medicine box render, high quality, standing on a white surface, realistic reflections."
  };

  try {
    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
      model: 'gemini-2.5-flash-image',
      contents: {
        parts: [
          { inlineData: { data: base64Data, mimeType } },
          { text: prompts[task] }
        ]
      }
    });

    for (const part of response.candidates?.[0].content.parts || []) {
      if (part.inlineData) {
        return `data:image/png;base64,${part.inlineData.data}`;
      }
    }

    throw error;

};
